```{r}
# Making sure packages are loaded
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(lubridate)

# The messy metadata provided by your colleague
island_metadata <- tibble(
  island_name = c(" biscoe", "Dream ", "Torgersen"),
  station_install = c("15/01/2003", "22-03-2004", "05/11/2001"),
  latitude = c(-64.81, -64.73, -64.76)
)

print(island_metadata)
#loading in penguins dataset 
penguins <- palmerpenguins::penguins

#2.11 
#Excerise 1 
#making clean_metadata from island metadata by changing island_name to island and adjusting the station_install with to date objects
clean_metadata <- island_metadata %>%
  mutate(station_install = dmy(station_install)) %>%  #changes the station_install column to date objects using dmy function from lubridate package 
  mutate (island_name = str_trim(island_name)) %>% #removes whitespace from island_name column
  mutate(island_name = str_to_title(island_name))#changes the first letter of each word in island_name column to uppercase

print(clean_metadata)

#Excerise 2 - Relational Join
#joining clean meta data to the main penguins dataset 
penguins_spatial <- penguins |> left_join(clean_metadata, by = join_by(island == island_name))

#checking to see the new columns were added correctly 
head(penguins_spatial)

#Excerise 3 - The Wide Summary Matrix 
#Using penguins_spatial dataset, removing all missing values in body_mass_g, grouping by species and island, and summarising the data to find the maximum body mass (max()) and then pivoting the dataset wider so that the species form rows and the islands form the columns 

penguins_summary <- penguins_spatial %>%
  filter(!is.na(body_mass_g)) %>% #removes all missing values in body_mass_g column
  group_by(species, island) %>% #groups the data by species and island
  summarise(max_body_mass = max(body_mass_g), .groups = "drop") %>% #summarises the data to find the maximum body mass for each group
  pivot_wider(names_from = island, values_from = max_body_mass) #pivots the dataset wider so that the species form rows and the islands form the columns

#checking the summary
penguins_summary
```
